::: {.member-profile-summary}
Ayrat Abdullin is a Ph.D. Candidate in Geophysics at King Fahd University of Petroleum & Minerals (KFUPM). His work focuses on the intersection of Scientific Machine Learning (SciML) and computational geophysics, bridging theoretical deep learning with robust physical applications.

Before joining KFUPM, Ayrat served as a Lead Expert at TATNEFT Oil & Gas Company in Russia, managing cross-functional teams and leading R&D projects. He holds a Master of Science in Geosciences from Colorado State University and a Bachelor of Science in Geophysics from Kazan Federal University.
:::
::::

## Research interests

- Scientific Machine Learning (SciML) and Neural Operators (FNO/GNO)
- Generative Architectures & Diffusion Models
- Inverse Problems and Data Assimilation
- Real-Time Seismology and Edge-deployable AI
- Cross-Domain Applications (Sustainable geo-energy, continuous subsurface monitoring)
